notes: Golden set for scripts/eval_shopify_seo.py (Surface 61). Each entry is a Shopify resource the SEO generator proposes a title for. Promotion gate: >=90% of titles pass ALL quality checks AND every dup_group produces DISTINCT titles. Bump/append when a real miss is found. `subject` is the core concept the title must retain.
